svg.title: Current comparable accuracy heatmap
svg.desc: Heatmap of the latest available comparable accuracy metrics across completed and in-progress family-size lines. Hatched cells may be route-missing, incomplete, or withdrawn from direct comparison after response-format validation.
svg.text: Rows cover current comparable metrics. Hatched cells mark route-missing benchmarks, incomplete runs, or lines withdrawn from direct
Lighter cells mean lower accuracy; darker cells mean higher accuracy.
